1.e4 d5 2.Nf3 dxe4 3.Ng5.strategy: Moves the knight with tempo to a square where it hits e4 and f7, keeping the pawn recapture in reserve. White aims to use the pressure on f7 to gain time before regaining the pawn, or to set traps for a Black who clings to the extra pawn.

1.e4 d5 2.Nf3 dxe4 3.Ng5 Nf6.strategy: Defends the pawn with a developing move, but keeps the extra pawn at a price: White's pieces lead in development and f7 is under pressure, so Black has to be careful. Giving the pawn back at once is the safer way to a comfortable game.
